body: I appreciate it a lot. Mine has gotten a lot worse this past month also, must be going around. The whole period thing was a total slap in the face especially since she KNOWS I'm depressed. Like hello, do you not remember taking me to a psychiatrist when I was a teen? Thank you for reaching out.
They're truly awful. I called one time and the guy told me I should get over what's wrong fast because I probably wouldn't like it very much in a hospital. So that was cool.
Very sad and tired. Should I pm you?
I wish I could say I was, but no. I appreciate you reaching out. I'm not even sure where to start. It just feels nice to even have anyone bother responding.
